name: rc2t
label: rare_chars
note: Token-only rare_chars detector, version 2 (tokenizer-agnostic). Online input is generated token ids only. Uses a 21-input 65-tree GBDT over universal Unicode character priors (mapped onto any target vocabulary at load time) and stdlib national-charset rarity tiers, removing per-tokenizer corpus count tables. Accepts shipped names, .npz bundles, tokenizer.json paths, model directories, or in-memory Tokenizer instances. One token look-ahead; intercept and monitor tiers are computed in one pass.
